name: Bump & Grind Presents New Year's Eve at Lot Six
description: Bump & Grind's first ever New Year's Eve party, after nine years of R&B nights. It's intimate: only 100 tickets and no door sales. Ring in 2027 with throwbacks, slow jams, sing-a-longs, and a midnight countdown. Every ticket includes entry, one drink ticket, hors d'oeuvres, and fast-track entry to the after party at The Toothy Moose. The first 50 tickets also come with a free 2027 season pass: free cover to every Bump & Grind event next year. 19+, valid government ID required.
